svg.title: Crash trials that charged the order twice
svg.desc: A grid of dots, one dot per trial, for six rows of saver and durability mode and five kill points, in two panels. The left panel is the graph on the Mac with no model, five trials per cell: 80 of 150 ran the effect twice. The right panel is the Qwen3 4B agent on the x86 server guest with no key, one bar of twenty trials per cell with the count that charged twice: 331 of 560 killed trials charged twice. Every kill inside the tool charged twice, and sync with a kill after the step charged once.
svg.text: not killed, exit mode never reached it
Totals: graph 80 of 150, agent 331 of 560 killed with no key.
Keyed on the thread and order id: graph 0 of 150, agent 0 of 140 killed.
